system.description:
Provoke – Provoked

You are provoked, finding it difficult to ignore the provoker with an instinctual desire to bring harm to them. Provoked is treated as a Mental condition.

While Provoked, if you attack or cast a jutsu targeting or affecting a creature other than the one that provoked you, you suffer a -2 penalty to your attack rolls against those creatures. The penalty to attack rolls increases by -1 at 10th (-3) and 17th (-4) levels.

While Provoked, if you attack or cast a jutsu targeting or affecting a creature other than the one that provoked you, you suffer a -1 to your Jutsu save DCs against those creatures. The penalty to your jutsu save DC’s increases by -1 at 10th (-2) and 17th (-3) levels.

While Provoked, if you attack or cast a jutsu targeting or affecting a creature other than the one that provoked you, the attack made or jutsu cast can also trigger opportunity attacks from the Provoker.

The Weapon Specialist who follows the Obsidian Guard Doctrine learns not the art of destruction, but of endurance. Like the black stone from which their name is taken, they are unyielding, unbreakable, and unmovable. Trained in the use of heavy flails, crushing hammers, and shields that deflect even the fiercest strikes, an Obsidian Guard anchors the battlefield. Their fighting style blends relentless defense with calculated reprisal.
